title: Financial Management Resource Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS, DC P&R
raw_text:
3. MOS 3408, Financial Management Resource Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS,
DC P&R

    a. Summary. Financial Management Resource Officers formulate and
supervise the execution of policies and procedures pertaining to the
accounting for appropriated funds supporting the operating forces and
supporting establishments. Specific duties and tasks may include but are not
limited to the supervision of financial management resource offices, advising
commanders and comptrollers on technical aspects of accounting policy,
procedures and Governmental accounting, maintaining a working knowledge of
the Accounting system, identifying and reporting financial systems problems,
validating accounting records for accuracy, evaluating and analyzing
financial information, performing trend analysis and business process
reengineering for effective and efficient use of financial resources,
providing financial training to the various stakeholders, tracking accounting
system changes, collaborating with interface partners, serving as a liaison
with Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), serving as the financial
management system expert, coordinating interfaces between business feeder
systems and the accounting system, and maintaining a working knowledge of the
financial reporting tools.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligible.

        (2) Must have Department of Defense Financial Management
Certification Level II.

        (3) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession.

        (4) Must have previously served in MOS 3451. Waivers can be granted
only by the OccFld manager or CMC upon package review and interview.

        (5) Must have completed the Advanced Resource Management Course
(ARMC) (M03FNF0) at the Financial Management School, MCB Camp Lejeune, NC.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC) (M02RMN4) within
18 months of appointment to WO (required).

        (2) Complete and maintain the appropriate level DoD FM certification
in accordance with DoDI 1300.26 and amplifying Marine Corps guidance
(required).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (w), Financial Management (FM) Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Accountants and Auditors 13-2011.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
